meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 获得两个新工具:列出 Atomic Chat 中的本地模型、向指定模型发提示并取回回答。Claude 仍负责统筹,但可以把部分任务交给本地模型。
howto.when: 安装注册后,工具对代理常驻可用;当用户提到 Atomic Chat 或要求使用本地模型时,代理会调用它,例如“用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都”。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: 代理会先列出模型,再生成回答

say.text: 先列出 Atomic Chat 里的模型,再选一个回答我的问题
say.note: 演示列表与生成两个工具配合

say.text: 用 atomic_chat_generate 让本地模型总结下面这段文字

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains two tools: list local models available in Atomic Chat, and send a prompt to a chosen model to get its response. Claude remains the orchestrator but can offload tasks to local models.
howto.when_en: After installation and registration, tools are always exposed; the agent calls them when the user mentions Atomic Chat or asks to use local models.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: The agent lists models, then generates an answer.

say_en.text: List Atomic Chat models, then pick one to answer my question
say_en.note: Shows the two tools working together.

say_en.text: Use atomic_chat_generate to have a local model summarize this text
